title: New Generalized Dual Banach Frames
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive formulation and a systematic investigation of g-dual Banach frames in a Banach space X and its dual space X?. We study the fundamental structural properties of these frames and establish sufficient conditions for their existence. Furthermore, we explore their relationships with other generalized notions of duality in Banach frame theory. Finally, we investigate the stability of g- dual Banach frames under bounded perturbations, demonstrating their robustness and potential applications in functional analysis.
